compiled_state.title: [reconciler/_advisory_lock]: concurrent tickets-ref advance between read and update-ref CAS -> run_pass abort_due_to_error skips reconcile pass
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 183fd51ac2ce99c42ff004bb65808de8d36def8c
* **component:** plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_advisory_lock.py (acquire_pass_lock / _write_file_to_tickets_branch / _delete_file_from_tickets_branch)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

acquire_pass_lock should succeed (or fail with a legitimate lock-held error) under concurrent tickets-branch writers. The compare-and-swap (CAS) advance of refs/heads/tickets is expected to be retried when a concurrent writer advances the ref between the old-sha read and the update-ref CAS — analogous to rebase_retry's drift handling. run_pass should not silently abort a reconcile pass purely because of a benign CAS race.

#### Actual Behavior

acquire_pass_lock (via _write_file_to_tickets_branch) does a single-shot `git update-ref refs/heads/tickets <new> <old>` CAS. When ANY concurrent tickets-branch writer (ticket-CLI event commits, per-pass bindings commits from cf93b2b7ad, agent comments) advances the ref between the `rev-parse tickets` (old_sha) read and the CAS, `git update-ref` exits 128 (old-sha mismatch). `_git_run` raises CalledProcessError -> write_fn raises -> rebase_retry returns Result(ok=False, kind="abort_due_to_error"). The outer retry loop in acquire_pass_lock only retries `reject_and_reschedule`, so abort_due_to_error breaks immediately and ReconcileLockError is raised. run_pass then ABORTS the pass ("abort_due_to_error"), silently skipping the reconcile pass.

Observed 4x in probe run /tmp/probe-gate5.*.log (pass_ids 2026-06-04T23-20-18, 23-21-44, 2026-06-05T00-14-23, 01-36-42). GHA never sees it (single-flight, one writer); local multi-writer development reproduces it. _delete_file_from_tickets_branch (release path) has the identical single-shot CAS pattern.

### 6. Logs

probe_ts 1780614899, /tmp/probe-gate5.*.log — 4 passes abort_due_to_error at the update-ref CAS.
